commands_used: answer 1. I woke in a barge hold with strangers; the door is locked. A cook named Okeeh is watching me. I do not know why I am here. 2. Speak to Okeeh in Barge Hold (marker). 3. Talk to Okeeh; maybe pick the locked door with my lockpick, or talk to Dralin Uveran. 4. I do not know who Okeeh or Dralin Uveran are, or what the work roll is; I can find out by talking.

answer 1. I am in a work barge hold at Ashgate Landing, serving the Owing (months of owed work cutting reed instead of a cell). The door stays locked until gang-master Dralin Uveran takes our names. 2. Tell Okeeh my trade, here in the hold. 3. She offers seven trade topics (fighter, hunter, thief, poultice-maker, etc.); I can also ask about the Owing, Hist, Jal-Veesa. 4. I do not understand Hist or Jal-Veesa; I can ask Okeeh. I also have not yet given my name.

answer 1. I told Okeeh I was a hunter and my skills rose; the hold door is now unbarred. I am serving the Owing under gang-master Dralin Uveran. 2. Go out onto the landing at Ashgate Landing via the door. 3. Leave through the door, or first ask Okeeh about Hist and Jal-Veesa. 4. Still do not know what Hist or Jal-Veesa are; can ask Okeeh.

answer 1. My name was struck from the Owing roll by order of Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. She wants me at her house; I do not know why. 2. Go east up the road to Jal-Veesa, to Vosh-Leera house; on the way Reed-Sill Weir has Sithis beard moss the tree-minder wants. 3. Go straight to Jal-Veesa, or gather the moss at the creek below the weir (crocodiles) first. 4. I do not know why Vosh-Leera wants me, or what the Hist tree is; I could ask in Jal-Veesa.

answer I am Wanderer, a hunter by trade (skills raised). I woke on an Owing barge at Ashgate Landing; gang-master Dralin Uveran says my name was struck from his roll on an order from Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe nothing. She wants me at her house in Jal-Veesa, east up the road; I do not know why. On the way is Reed-Sill Weir, where the tree-minder wants Sithis beard (grey moss) from the creek below, with crocodiles. I carry a lockpick. Still unknown: what Hist and Jal-Veesa mean in detail, and why she wants me.
